conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Zigbee and Z-Wave are both mesh network technologies, but they operate on different radio frequencies and have varying ranges and device capacities. Z-Wave typically has a longer range and fewer interference issues, while Zigbee often supports more devices on a single network.
